symbols.name: State x
symbols.definition: Modeled state of the declared effective plant; for a mechanical model, the generalized coordinates and their velocities.

symbols.name: Drift f(x)
symbols.definition: Complete autonomous drift of the declared effective plant: its evolution when the declared control is zero, including every retained state-dependent load.

symbols.name: Input map G(x)
symbols.definition: Matrix or collection of control vector fields that multiplies the declared control; uppercase G throughout control-affine equations.

symbols.name: Control input u
symbols.definition: Declared control input: the channel a counterfactual sets to zero. State its physical level and admissible set.

symbols.name: Mass matrix M(q)
symbols.definition: Generalized inertia matrix: the symmetric positive-definite kinetic-energy metric in the chosen coordinates.

symbols.name: Generalized coordinates q
symbols.definition: Joint or body coordinates in the mechanical state.

symbols.name: Generalized velocity q-dot
symbols.definition: Time derivative of the generalized coordinates.

symbols.name: Bias load h
symbols.definition: Velocity-dependent, gravity, passive, and constraint loads in the equation $M(q)\ddot q+h=B(q)u$.

symbols.name: Auxiliary state z
symbols.definition: Declared auxiliary coordinates or frozen strategy variables in the effective plant.

symbols.name: Model parameters p
symbols.definition: Contact mode, frozen impedance, and other declared frozen parameters collected in $p$.

symbols.name: Generalized control tau
symbols.definition: Applied generalized force or torque in the ZVCF evaluation protocol.

symbols.name: Coriolis matrix C(q, q-dot)
symbols.definition: Velocity-product matrix of the kinetic model; C times the generalized velocity gives the Coriolis and centrifugal loads.

symbols.name: Gravity vector g(q)
symbols.definition: Gravity generalized-force vector, the gradient of the gravitational potential; lowercase g is reserved for gravity.

symbols.name: Actuation matrix B(q)
symbols.definition: Maps the declared control input to generalized forces, so the applied load is B(q) times u.

symbols.name: Drift acceleration block
symbols.definition: Drift contribution in the task or acceleration space used in the DCR.

symbols.name: Actuation acceleration map
symbols.definition: Control block mapping admissible inputs to acceleration in the DCR.

symbols.name: DCR weighting W
symbols.definition: Declared scaling or metric for DCR norms.

symbols.name: Admissible control set
symbols.definition: Set of admissible control vectors at state $x$ for the DCR supremum.

symbols.name: DCR regularizer epsilon
symbols.definition: Regularizer preventing division by zero in the DCR denominator.

symbols.name: Constraint Jacobian J
symbols.definition: Constraint or task Jacobian; rows are individual constraints.

symbols.name: Velocity vector v
symbols.definition: Linear velocity vector (bold or bar notation in prose tables).

symbols.name: Lambda
symbols.definition: Eigenvalue or Lagrange multiplier depending on context.
